tldr: Across the 5 services with 6-month Local Falcon history (chiropractor, acupuncture, cold laser, dry needling, deep tissue), portfolio top-3 cells went 35 → 64 (+29) and top-10 cells went 140 → 144 (+4) between Nov 21 2025 and May 15 2026. Deep tissue massage is the engine of that lift: 18 top-3 cells at baseline, 47 today (+29, mean dx +4.26), nearest competitor at 25. Cold laser is the surprise: from 1 to 8 top-3 cells with a +7.5 mean rank dx, mostly through specialty long-tail. The two newest tracked queries (massage near me, massage therapy near me) show net-new visibility from near-zero. The bleed sits on pregnancy/prenatal massage where Sage Blossom's 209-review pin took 8 top-3 cells on pregnancy-massage-near-me alone since Mar 12. DataForSEO confirms 15 services where Deep Relief sits #1–#3 at the storefront but falls past top-20 portfolio-wide. The work is off-pin reach (service pages, city-modifier slugs), not adding to tracking. GA4 still not connected (Owner Ask OA-1).

headline.h2: Six months of Local Falcon history: portfolio top-10 cells +4 on the 5 long-history kws. Deep tissue massage drove most of the lift.
headline.lede:
Across the 5 services with continuous Local Falcon coverage since Nov 21 2025 (chiropractor, acupuncture, cold laser austin, dry needling near me, deep tissue massage): portfolio top-10 footprint grew from 140 to 144 cells (+4), top-3 cells from 35 to 64 (+29). Deep tissue massage carried the lift: 18 top-3 cells in November to 47 today, and the moat is now decisive (nearest competitor at 25). Cold laser austin moved from 1 to 8 top-3 cells with a +7.5 mean rank delta, opening up on specialty long-tail even though the category-exact Laser Therapy Clinic-Austin still owns the head queries. Acupuncture and dry needling softened (mean dx -3.2 and -3.8), as neither service has a dedicated landing page today.

Two new tracked queries entered the dataset in October 2025 with near-zero visibility: massage near me (40,500 Austin DMA/mo) and massage therapy near me. Both lifted hard: massage near me from 0 to 1 top-3 + 53 visible cells, massage therapy near me from 3 to 20 top-3 cells. The bleed remains pregnancy/prenatal massage where Sage Blossom's 209-review pin has been taking share over the last 60 days.

GSC over the same window: 7,839 clicks against 945,867 impressions, sitewide CTR 0.83%. Impressions +2.8% H2 vs H1 (reach is healthy) while non-brand earns 0.4% CTR vs brand's 22%, so click capture (not reach) is the bottleneck. GA4 is still not connected so conversion-side measurement remains the single largest open question.

levers.name: Defend the deep-tissue moat: don't lose ground to growing competitors
levers.why: Deep tissue massage is the only query where Deep Relief has portfolio-defining ownership (47 top-3 cells; nearest competitor Deeply Therapeutic at 25). Slight rank softening (avg 5.07 → 5.51, mean dx -0.13) and 3-cell top-3 loss show this isn't permanent. Sage Blossom’s 209-review listing and AUSTINDEEP Barton Creek are the watch-list.
actions: Sustain GBP posting cadence specifically tagging deep tissue massage on photos + posts.
Schema-mark /services/massage-therapy/ as MedicalTherapy with hasOfferCatalog including DeepTissueMassage.
Internal link the deep tissue massage service page from every top-traffic blog (currently mostly orphaned).
Run /services/deep-tissue-massage-austin/ as a dedicated landing page (currently folded into massage hub).
levers.outcome: Hold 45+ top-3 cells; widen top-10 from 73 to 80+; ensure rank doesn’t drift past 6.0 avg.

levers.name: Counter Sage Blossom on pregnancy/prenatal massage: reverse the bleed
levers.why: Sage Blossom Massage (209-rev listing) holds 62 top-3 cells on pregnancy-massage-near-me to DR’s 26 and is gaining (+6 portfolio-wide). DR lost 8 top-3 cells on pregnancy-massage-near-me alone and dropped #1 cells from 7 to 2. This is the largest single category bleed.
actions: Build a dedicated /services/prenatal-massage-austin/ landing page (currently lives only as a Massage sub-section).
Add pregnancy-massage trust signals to homepage and GBP description: certifications, training, body cushion equipment.
Push 3 prenatal-massage GBP posts per month with client photos (with permission) for the next 90 days.
Run a backlink push targeting Austin Mom blogs, doula directories (Austin Birth Doulas, Austin Childbirth Trust), and prenatal yoga studios for referral + citation.
levers.outcome: Recover 8+ top-3 cells on pregnancy-massage-near-me; widen top-10 reach by 10+ cells.

levers.name: Convert pin-strong, grid-weak queries into off-pin reach
levers.why: DataForSEO Maps SERP at the storefront shows Deep Relief at #1–#3 at the pin for 15 services (~48K monthly Austin DMA searches). Local Falcon is already tracking the same kws on the wider grid, where their avg ranks portfolio-wide sit at 17–20+, which means the at-pin win evaporates within 1–2 miles of the storefront. The work isn’t tracking; the work is reach. Service-page builds with city-modifier slugs are the path Sage Blossom is already running on pregnancy massage.
actions: Build dedicated /services/{service}-austin/ landing pages for the 5 highest-volume pin-strong queries (chiropractor near me at 3,600/mo, massage therapy austin at 590, deep tissue massage austin at 590, acupuncture austin at 1,000, cupping therapy austin at 170), each with LocalBusiness + Service schema.

Add /services/{service}-{suburb}/ city-modifier pages for the 3 nearest suburbs (Sunset Valley, Oak Hill, Dripping Springs) on the top 2-3 commercial services. Modeled on the same matrix Sage Blossom is using on pregnancy.
After 4 weeks of new landing-page indexation, re-scan the same 8 queries in Local Falcon and compare cell-by-cell against the May 15 baseline. Off-pin reach (cells 2-3 miles out) is the KPI.

Drop cryo spa / cryo spa near me / cryo spa austin from LF tracking (DR doesn’t offer cryo, those scans are noise). Drop accupuncture near me (misspelling; Google auto-corrects, so it’s a duplicate of acupuncture near me). Frees up 4 LF tracking slots for higher-leverage kws.
levers.outcome: Same 8 LF queries: off-pin reach (2-3 mi band) lifts +20% in cells visible, +50% in cells top-10. Frees 4 LF slots.

levers.name: Connect GA4: close the conversion-side measurement blackout
levers.why: GA4 is not connected. We can see GSC clicks (7,839 in 365d), Maps reach, and competitor movement, but we cannot see leads, calls, bookings, or revenue. With 96.6% of impressions non-brand and 0.4% CTR there, the click → booking ratio is the single most actionable diagnostic we can’t run.
actions: Owner ask: grant info@hqdm.io editor access to the Deep Relief GA4 property (or share property ID if it already exists).

Once connected: rebuild conversion stack (form submits + click_phone + click_email + booking confirmations) and categorize events per BB Massage convention (booking + lead = TRUE conversion, calls = qualified intent, GBP listing taps = engagement, not conversion).
Wire GTM-side phone-click and form-submit tracking if missing.
levers.outcome: Conversion-side picture matches the maps-side picture; we can attribute lift to the right lever.

levers.name: Click-capture: lift sitewide CTR off 0.83% (the impressions are already there)
levers.why: GSC shows 945,867 impressions and only 7,839 clicks (0.83% CTR). Brand queries (3.4% of impressions) earn 63.8% of clicks (~22% CTR); non-brand (96.6% of impressions) earns 0.4% CTR. The supply problem is solved, but the demand-capture problem isn’t. Title + meta + result-snippet rewrites are the unblocked work.
actions: Run a title-tag + meta-description rewrite across the top 25 non-brand pages by impressions (priority on those at position 4–15).
Add FAQ / HowTo schema to long-form service pages so the SERP card is fuller.
Build out specific service-page H1s that match high-impression query phrasing (e.g., add “Austin” to service-page titles where the query specifies metro).
A/B observe over 60 days; expand pattern to remaining pages if CTR moves >0.3pp.
levers.outcome: Move sitewide CTR from 0.83% to 1.20%+ within 90 days, worth ~3,500 additional clicks/yr at current impressions.

levers.name: Concede cold-laser: it’s a category-aligned competitor moat
levers.why: Laser Therapy Clinic-Austin (28 reviews, 3.9★) holds 133/133 top-3 cells on cold-laser-austin at avg rank 2.17 (they’re the exact-name match). Austin Laser Solutions runs 2 locations splitting #2/#3. Deep Relief is currently 8 top-3 cells out of 46 visible, a real position but capped by category mismatch. Spending on this query is low-leverage.
actions: Keep the cold laser landing page; do NOT invest in additional content/links for cold-laser-specific queries.
Re-target the cold-laser landing page to capture ‘cold laser + condition’ long-tail (knee pain, plantar fasciitis, peripheral neuropathy), where fewer competitors compete.
Remove cold-laser-specific GBP posting cadence; redirect that production to deep-tissue + pregnancy-massage content.
levers.outcome: Stop wasting attention on an unwinnable surface; redirect to leverage-positive queries.
